lessons: Check failed on two requisition findings against the authored core-drift-activation seed, not on pytest. Green suites and an 'ok' run record did not cover requisition review.

The only resolver from routing to conduct files is inline in __main__._core. The plan's fixed fence for core-drift-activation excludes squatch/__main__.py, so the gate must either hook an unfenced module or copy the mapping into a second resolver.

Copying the provider-to-filename mapping into hostfiles or gates would break the no-dual-path rule and let core and core_drift disagree on managed files. The plan must fence __main__.py or move the resolver to a fenced seam.

test_classifier_is_unreachable_from_production_gates forbids production imports or calls of hostfiles.classify. Activating the gate contradicts it, and no acceptance criterion names that test's migration.
test_rendering_has_no_git_or_commit_effect pins hostfiles imports to {hashlib, re, typing}. That limits where the gate and its routing lookup can live, and the ticket does not say so.
No fix is reachable inside the tickets/test fence. Fix section 20 first (the core-drift-activation fence, the resolver seam, and the test migrations), then regenerate this ticket from the plan.
